newsitem.title: CANADA: Intensity mails directors' circular on bid.
newsitem.headline: Intensity mails directors' circular on bid.

text.p: Intensity Resources Ltd said on Monday it mailed its directors' circular in response to Renata Resources Inc's C$110-million takeover offer for the company.

Intensity chief executive Gary Freeman said he was strongly urging shareholders not to tender their holdings until Intensity's board issued their recommendation on whether to accept or reject the bid.
"The board of directors of Intensity will explore the full range of strategic opportunities for increasing shareholder value," Freeman said in a statement.
Renata has offered C$2.25 cash or 1.875 Renata shares for each Intensity share.
Intensity said its board would issue a recommendation at least a week before the April 18 expiry of Renata's bid.
